subject: Studio return: status-only readiness and current-mail check
body: Status-only check-in from CFA Nova: Ziggy has asked the existing studio team to wake and report readiness. Read current mail addressed to gemini_studio in docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/mailbox/messages and its receipts. Do not restart older jobs from those messages. Report readiness, latest checkpoint, blockers, actual current surface/session and what you actually read. If you cannot access local mail, say so rather than claiming readback. Preserve current project sessions, ownership, models, sources and all review/release holds. This authorizes no production work, generation, batch, purchase, model change or new/replacement agent/session. Reply once to this message with the same conversationId and replyTo; a posted file alone is not an externally delivered wake.
